name: ArenaCatSlot
description: A slot in the categorical ramp, in fixed order and never cycled. Colour here means which thing, never what state. The same ramp the charts use (identity is one system across Arena, not one per component), but typed as an enum only here: ArenaBarChart, ArenaLineChart and ArenaDoughnutChart series still declare a bare number, which their runtime clamp (arenaCatColor()) makes safe rather than correct, and narrowing them is an open contract change and not a fact this type states. The bound is not authored here either: it is the count of --color-cat-* slots in contracts/design/palette.dark.json, and check:script-tokens fails if this set stops matching it.
